basics.title: Macluumaad aasaasi ah
basics.description: Nambarrada degdegga, iyo halka laga bilaabo haddii aad cusub tahay.
basics.emergencyBody: Nambarradan waa bilaash taleefan kasta, iyada oo aan loo baahnayn kredit ama SIM, habeen iyo maalin. Weydiiso turjubaan haddii aad u baahan tahay.
basics.number.emergencyHint: Lambarka degdegga Yurub ee booliska, ambalaanska ama dab-damiska. Wuu shaqeeyaa Midowga Yurub oo dhan.
basics.number.ambulanceHint: Cudur daran, dhaawac, daawo xad-dhaaf ah, calaamado halis ah oo uur la xiriira, ama xaalad caafimaad degdeg ah.
basics.number.policeHint: Rabshad, khatar, tuugo, ama qof kaa hanjabaya.
basics.number.fireHint: Dab, shil, badbaadin, ama qof ku xannibmay.
basics.number.shelterHint: Caawimaad bulsho degdeg ah iyo codsi hoy. Meel had iyo jeer lama helo.
basics.number.deaf: Dhega la’, maqal xun, ama aan hadli karin
basics.number.deafHint: Adeeg degdeg ah oo qoraal ah dadka dhega la’, maqalka ku adag, aan hadli karin, ama aan si ammaan ah u hadli karin. Fariin dir; hadal ha wacin.
basics.number.seaRescueHint: Halis badda. Lambarkan wuxuu ku xiraa adeegga badbaadinta badda ee Faransiiska, kuwaas oo diri kara gurmad.
basics.help.seaRescueHint: Taageero degdeg ah dadka halis ku jira badda. Marka hore had iyo jeer la xiriir adeegyada rasmiga ah ee badbaadinta badda — 112 ama 196. Alarm Phone waxay gudbin kartaa digniinta, laakiin ma bixiso gaadiid mana abaabusho tallaabo goos-goos ah. Waa inaad awoodo inaad sheegto goobta aad joogto.
basics.help.shelterNightHint: Taageero dadka waaweyn iyo caruurta, qalab lagama maarmaan ah, hagitaan, iyo caawimaad ka dib rabshad la sheegay. La xiriir ururka si aad ogaato waxa hadda la heli karo.
basics.help.evictionsHint: Indha-indheyn madax bannaan iyo hagitaan sharci ka dib buux-dhaafis, luminta ama qabsashada alaabta, ama rabshad la sheegay. Waxay diiwaan gelin karaan wixii dhacay oo kaa caawin karaan helitaanka talo sharci.
basics.waterHint: Meelaha biyaha bilaashka ah iyo waqtiyada qubayska agagaarkaaga.
basics.newHereBody: Ka bilow waxa muhiim ah maalmaha ugu horreeya: halka wax lagu cuno, lagu maydho, dhakhtar lagu arko, iyo talo lagu helo; tallaabo tallaabo.
basics.needs: Hel waxa aad u baahan tahay
activities.title: Waxqabadyo iyo adeegyo
activities.description: Sifee waxqabadyada dadweynaha ee la dib-u-eegay, is barbardhig faahfaahinta muhiimka ah, ama isticmaal khariidadda xogta yar si aad u aragto goobaha dadweynaha ee saxda ah.
activities.search: Ku raadi waxqabad, baahi, goob ama bixiye
activities.empty: Ma jiro waxqabad la daabacay oo ku habboon sifeeyayaashan.
activities.mapHint: Calaamadaha waxay muujinayaan booska isku dhafan ee goobaha loo oggolaaday bandhig dadweyne oo sax ah.
activities.noMap: Waxqabadyadan midkoodna kuma laha goob dadweyne oo sax ah khariidadda.
activities.contactForPlace: La xiriir bixiyaha si aad u ogaato goobta
activities.location.privacy: Goobtaada waxaa loo isticmaalaa boggan oo kaliya si loo dhigo khariidadda. Lama keydiyo, looma diro InfoKit, lagumana daro falanqaynta.
activities.location.denied: Ogolaanshaha goobta lama bixin. Liiska buuxa ee waxqabadyada weli wuu diyaar yahay.
activities.location.unavailable: Goobta laguma heli karo qalabkan. Liiska buuxa ee waxqabadyada weli wuu diyaar yahay.
activities.location.error: Goobtaada lama heli karin. Isku day mar kale ama isticmaal liiska waxqabadyada.
organization.activitiesEmpty: Weli waxqabad kastaba lama daabicin. Astaantooda halkan ayaa ku taal si aad u ogaato cidda ay yihiin.
listen.title: Dhageyso boggan
listen.description: Riix ciyaar si aad u maqasho macluumaadkan. Codka waxaa la sameeyaa marka la codsado, wuxuuna isticmaali karaa xogta moobilka.
listen.aiDisclosure: Codkan waxaa sameeyay sirdoon macmal ah; ma aha cod qof duubay.
